links.outcome: Readability of handouts before vs after ChatGPT-4 rewriting at 6th-grade level
links.effect: LLM-revised handouts averaged seventh-grade reading level; Flesch-Kincaid Reading Ease 70.8 vs 43.9 (P<.05); Gunning Fog 10.2 vs 14.42; SMOG 9.9 vs 13.1; ARI 8.2 vs 10.7 (P=.06).
links.quote: Conversely, the LLM-revised handouts had an average seventh-grade reading level.

links.outcome: PEMAT understandability and actionability of native vs LLM-revised handouts
links.quote: PEMAT scores were significantly higher in the LLM-revised handouts for understandability (91 vs 74%; P < .05) with similar actionability (42 vs 34%; P = .15) when compared to the standard materials.
